_doc: Breadcrumb-checker flags reviewed on the page by the main session (2026-11-13): each flagged path reads as a consistent breadcrumb; the flag comes from a numbering or front-matter heuristic. Keys: doc -> {node id: reason}. '*' = every flag of that kind in the doc.

FRONT._reason: contents/preface title nested under a section that names it or contains it: '第一节 重要提示、目录和释义 › 目录' (the section title names the contents), 'FORM 10-K … › INDEX' (contents of the embedded filing), '第一节 物权变动 › 序言：…' (opening section of the chapter), 'Preface › Other Boring Stuff › Acknowledgements' (printed as a preface subsection)

ROOTS._reason: the document prints no title (untitled excerpt, notes, olympiad paper, solution sheet, budget excerpt): its top sections are the top level and each path starts there

NUM._reason: the document prints a second 一、二、三 sequence inside an 一、 section; the path '一、报告期内公司从事的主要业务 › 一、To B端业务' is a narrower step

DEEP._reason: numbered list items 1.–12. inside section 1.2 (a list numbered within the section, not section numbers): '1.2产品硬件配置 › 1. CPU' is a narrower step

SEQ._reason: numbering as printed by the document (two consecutive '1.3' slides; '2、' printed twice; handwritten notes restart their numbering or skip an item; photos out of notebook order); each path itself is a narrower step
